dedupe_keys.name: predictive maintenance dataset for elevator doors huawei munich research center

description: This Zenodo deposit contains anonymised predictive maintenance data from elevator door systems, released by Cristian Axenie and Stefano Bortoli of the Huawei Munich Research Center to help reduce unplanned stops and extend equipment life. Three sensor types are recorded: an electromechanical door ball bearing sensor, a humidity sensor and a vibration sensor, sampled at 4 Hz during the high-peak and evening periods from 16:30 to 23:30. The record holds a ZIP archive of time series operation data, version 1.0.0 published on 7 February 2020, free to download with an open licence labelled Other (Open) on Zenodo, and links to a GitHub repository. Coverage is elevator doors at unnamed sites, so no place or building is identified. Caveats: the size figures on the page differ between the compressed archive and total volume, failure labels and site details are not described, and there is no update plan. It suits building operations and digital twin work on vertical transport maintenance. Related catalogue record: data-gis-b-me-elevator-maintenance-scheduling-benchmark.
